notes.title: SPIRITS OF BACIU TEASER REVEAL!
notes.content:
Hello Spirit Friends!🤘

We hope you guys are all ok! 

We're happy to show you  the first teaser for Spirits of Baciu! 🎬 🍿  🥳 
[previewyoutube=aawVl1OY7jc;full][/previewyoutube]

You can have a sneak peek of:

 the new jump mechanic and animation
 the polished version of the Lost One
 camera that follows the character in longer stages
 more info once you collect an object


But the most important things are that we finally have:

 the Steam page for the full game 🎉 
 the incoming Kickstarter campaign 🎉


So if you'd like to support us, please Add the game to your Wishlist and Pre-save the Kickstarter campaign! ❤️ 

In the next months we'll show you updates and work in progress 🎮

Feel free to share with everyone interested! Your help, as always, means the world to us! 🧡



Horns Level Up 🤘

notes.title: Important update
notes.content:
Hi everyone
We have completed an update hoping to resolve the "black screen" issue that some players have been experiencing.
Many of you will lose your saves... we know it might bother you but we think it is right to also think of the players who have had problems with the "black screen".
We haven't had much time to test this version, if it causes serious problems we will go back to the previous build.
Thanks again and sorry for the inconvenience.
We promise you that this won't happen in the next chapter.

Horns Level Up

notes.title: 3 KEYS GIVEAWAY!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Do you remeber the giveway for 3 winners from our mailing list  that we announced some months ago?
Well, here we are! On 18th September we'll draw 3 winners! 

In case you haven't, you can subscribe here:   https://www.hornslevelup.com/sort 

The 3 winners will receive for free (once released) :

🔑 Digital Copy of the Game (Steam Key)
🎨 3 4K Wallpapers
🎨 Digital Artbook
🎵 Digital Soundtrack
📕 Physical Artbook (EUROPE ONLY)

Remember that everyone can partecipate but if the winner is from extra Europe only digital rewards will be sent and the physical artbook will not be included! Shipping only in EU to avoid custom fees problem. We hope you'll understand this choice!

But don't worry, if you don't win these tiers will be available in the Kickstarter campaign on 28th September 2023!

"Collector Spirit" reward including the Physical artbook for EU countries only (including also Name in credits) ✨  50€
"Friend Spirit" reward (including also Name in credits)  ✨ 20€

Many other rewards will be available so stay tuned don't forget to save the campaign to be notified on the launch day!  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hornslevelup/spirits-of-baciu-the-deception
